message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have sent the cancellation email. Now I need to follow up with Alison in the workspace to propose the next steps. I've confirmed that there are no available 30-minute slots. The only way forward is to see if any of the partners can move one of their existing meetings. I'll suggest this to Alison and ask her to check with Priya and Marcus, as she has visibility into their calendars. This is the most constructive way to move forward. After this, I'll end my session.

function.arguments: {"text":"I've conducted a thorough review of everyone's calendars, and it appears there are no common 30-minute slots available for all four partners next week.\n\nCould you please check with Priya and Marcus to see if they have any flexibility in their schedules? Perhaps one of them could move a less urgent meeting to free up some time. If you can find a potential slot on their end, I can then check with Elena and David. Let me know what you think."}
